svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/attenuator/ - Attenuator with accessories on one or two ports
When it is seen: like 16, for the attenuator measurement.
What to draw: like image 7 (VNA, attenuator in the middle) with the accessories on P1 and on P2
(P2 dashed) and the calibration plane before the accessories, as in 16.
Details: same setup as 16, so that it is seen that only the device changes.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
